newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Choppy gilts to look to support at 113.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Choppy gilts to look to support at 113.

text.p: September gilt futures traded on LIFFE will seek to hold above 113-00 on Wednesday but lack any real sense of direction, technical analysts said.
Fundamentals are likely to be the main influence on the market for now ahead of the British budget on July 2, they said.
"On a technical front there is no strong trend in place," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London. "Gilts will be choppy in the short term."
He said while the market held above 113-00 he was optimistic there would be sufficient buying interest for a re-test of 114-00 and Monday's high at 114-08.
At 0714 GMT, September gilt futures were at 113-17, up 1/32 on the day.

Cossor said 113-00 was a daily low and previous resistance level. If there is a break down through there, he said some interim support from hourly charts was offered at 112-15, 16 before the lows extended further down.
Below that area, an outside day low from May 28 came in at 112-05 and beneath that there was a further prop at 112-02, the low from May 22.
"On the day the main influence is going to be fundamentals in the shape of what happens with the data," Cossor said.

British May unemployment and April average earnings and unit wage costs are due at 0830 GMT. Unemployment is forecast to fall 40,000, compared with a 59,000 fall in April. Average earnings growth is forecast steady at 4.5 percent, unchanged from previously.
A trader at a British bank said he was surprised at the lack of buying interest in gilts, adding that the proximity of the budget was making investors nervous.
But he said they still represented good value as a safe haven from the European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) upsets.

"The contract has been very unhappy above 114-00 and it needs to decisively break above there before making any headway. But it has quite serious resistance in the way," he said, adding that 113-31, an intraday resistance level was likely to pen in any gains on Wednesday.
He said 114-14, the low on May 9 was a tough target before gilts could reach their contract high of 114-31.
To the downside, he placed support at 113-02, just below Tuesday's low at 113-04.
September short sterling futures were down one basis point at 93.07.
